title: Unheld evaluation may submit without source identity when recapture is unavailable
outcome: For a target with source_root requested without a held claim, a failed recapture at submission is either refused as final or has a recorded reason why the fallback is acceptable, with a test of whichever is chosen. Source: Claude session-17047 review of 8f544b45, src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs:2094. The 'never as unmeasured' guarantee holds only at request time. How Engram treats a source-less evaluation of a bound root wasn't verified.
acceptance: Unheld evaluation may submit without source identity when recapture is unavailable is done
